song_craft: Voice: śānta couplets, mirror-light register (still, clear, unforced). Arc: light unobjectifiable (v1) → non-duality (v2) → positive declaration with division inside (v3) → difference uncut + bare list (v4) → mirror a-fortiori (v5) → address: You alone (v6) → paradox praised (v7) → seal: hymn names its close (v8). Sthāyin śānta throughout; adbhuta/ānanda color single verses. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: O dense consciousness — therefore You alone are supreme; in You alone the worlds shine all at once.
And they flash by Your glory’s power — and You alone are their maker, the supreme Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃvidghanas tena parastvam eva tvayyeva viśvāni cakāsati drāk | sphuranti ca tvanmahasaḥ prabhāvāt tvam eva caiṣāṃ parameśakartā

verses.craft: Address held (row 7); You-alone tripled (aloneness anaphora); drāk scope unforced per UNC.
verses.rejected: (a) forcing drāk onto shining/flashing → killed by UNC. (b) maker→creator → killed: L3 frozen.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa ānanda (bliss) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
